name: Zombie Police ~Zombie Deka to Itetsuku Manatsu no Oshougatsu~
original_name: ゾンビポリス ～ゾンビ刑事と凍てつく真夏のお正月～
source:
Shimofuri Village lies frozen in the height of summer. Zombie detective Kabane Akemi and her junior partner Tamura Yasu investigate a tragedy during a VTuber's livestream. They gather testimony and use Akemi's ability to enter minds as they work to uncover the truth behind the case.

[Based on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
正值盛夏，霜降村却一片冰封。僵尸刑警尸明美与她的后辈搭档田村安，受命调查一起在VTuber直播期间发生的惨剧。两人四处搜集证言，并运用明美潜入他人内心的特殊能力，合力揭开案件背后的真相。

[改编自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649840/]Steam[/url]]
